title: Characterizing Online Toxicity During the 2022 Mpox Outbreak: A Computational Analysis of Topical and Network Dynamics

bias_targets.methodology: Filtering Twitter data using the Perspective API to identify toxic tweets, followed by BERT-based topic modeling (BERTopic) and manual categorization to isolate and quantify homophobic discourse targeting the LGBTQ+ community.

Filtering Twitter data using the Perspective API for toxicity, applying BERT-based topic modeling (BERTopic), and categorizing semantic clusters to identify racist discourse and racial slurs (e.g., anti-Black or anti-African narratives).
Using the Perspective API to detect toxic tweets and BERTopic modeling to identify discourse related to political polarization, conspiracy theories, and partisan attacks.
